last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Tue 07-28 — a DEEP-DIVE, learner-commissioned: Andrew asked for pakkam vs paakkalaam by name on 07-27 and it was paid off first, before any demand. THE HEADLINE IS A METHOD CHANGE, not a word: the minimal pair EXPLAINS the collision and does not FIRE it. I gave the full contrast (paar hiding inside paakkalaam, paarthen already his, long aa + the r vs pakkam's two flat beats) and ninety seconds later, under production load, he still said 'temple-ku pakkalam' — told the driver 'let us go look at a temple' for the second day running. What fixed it inside ONE exchange was dropping the pair and handing pakkathula as an INDIVISIBLE CHUNK — 'nothing to build, learn it like paravaayilla'. The diagnosis: while he is assembling pakkam + -la, the worn groove -alaam gets out of his mouth first. Assembly loses to retrieval under load. Apply this shape to every minimal pair from here — contrast to explain, chunk to fire. THE DONE-TAIL IS PAID (owed since 07-26, taught then, liked, never fired): he produced 'vandhuchu' COLD off an English situation, then unprompted took it apart himself — 'root is va, past vandhu, chu as finality'. Root and past were exactly right; the correction that landed was that -chu is only the neuter past and the FINALITY is -idu = விடு, 'to let go'. So vandhu+vidu+chu = 'it came and let go'. That tied straight to விட்டுடு, an ear-only deck item that had gone past him in Priya akka's tape SIX HOURS EARLIER — the etymology vein is what he is here for and it cost nothing. Keep aagum/aachu adjacent (yesterday's 'nooru rubaa aagum' misread as 'a hundred MORE' is the same sibling pair). THE -ku/-la TOGGLE IS HOLDING: 'temple-ku ponga' correct for motion and 'temple pakkathula' correct for position inside one ride, unprompted — Sunday he was giving hall-ku for 'at the hall'. Two shavings needed: -ku is vestigial on pakkathula (it already carries the at), and his word order puts the verb first ('ponga temple-ku') — Tamil is verb-final, worth one clause each, not a lecture. THE ANTIFREEZE ENDING LANDED: 'inga nirutthunga' fired COLD first ask with the -unga ATTACHED, the exact ending that evaporated four times in the 07-27 volley (medhuva pesa, sollen). That gap is closing. 'valadhu' came unprompted alongside it. MY OWN DOSING ERROR, logged so it does not repeat: I taught ulla and veliya as twins in one breath and then immediately cold-demanded one — he gave the one I had said last. Twins introduced together WILL collide; separate the demand from the teach by at least a beat. He also gave 'irukka' for 'irukken' — handed her own question back — and the -en = I beat (poren/paarthen/sollren all already his) fixed it in one. Also corrected his own 'oola' to ulla when asked, so his phonetic self-report is trustworthy. CARRIED, UNPAID: (1) 'yaaru?' taught 07-26, still never demanded — three sessions running now. (2) frame:youknow-la still uncaught; this morning's cousins-tape knock produced five exchanges of format confusion and zero catch — the eavesdrop lane is NOT working as a text knock, see the standing move below. (3) romba adhigam still seen-wanted-unfired, no slot existed today. (4) the -la negative tail (theriyala/saapidala) still not automatic in comprehension. STANDING MOVE (07-28, from the knock post-mortem): eavesdrop drills are EAR-ONLY — wire real audio or do not run them as a text knock, and phonetic-first everywhere in chat. The 🎧 plus 'on the phone' promises a clip that is not there, and Tamil script does not render on his lock screen; it has now failed twice in a row (Mala akka Sunday, Priya akka today). PLUMBING, not pedagogy: a CI race lost one judged exchange this morning (fixed and pushed, 90fef34); the local soak render is down on an SSL cert failure so today's tape did not go out; and a word taught in-session cannot enter the lexicon at all (parked in feature_inbox) — pakkathula, aachu and irukken were all refused at close, so today's best teaching is invisible to tomorrow's ticket. DENSITY LOW / LORE HIGH holds for a fourth session running: three cold fires and two etymology veins (the vidu-as-finality thread, the paar-inside-paakkalaam hook) again beat every gauntlet. Do not raise the dose while this keeps producing.
